read.thesis: FY25 sales +10% CER to DKK 309bn but 2026 adjusted sales guided -5% to -13% CER on US price cuts (MFN), semaglutide LOE and competition; capex still ~DKK 55bn with Catalent-driven capacity build.

capex.quote: Capital expenditure is expected to be around DKK 55 billion in 2026 compared to DKK 60 billion in 2025, reflecting the expansion of the global supply chain.

triggers.label: 2026 adj. sales growth -5% to -13% CER
triggers.quote: Adjusted sales growth for 2026, which excludes revenue from the reversal of 340B provisions, is expected to be -5 to -13% at CER.

triggers.label: Lower realised prices incl. MFN
triggers.quote: The sales outlook is impacted by lower realised prices including impacts related to the "Most Favoured Nations" agreement in the US

triggers.label: Intensifying competition, semaglutide LOE
triggers.quote: intensifying competition as well as negative impact from reduced obesity medication coverage in Medicaid

triggers.label: Capex ~DKK 55bn in 2026, declining after
triggers.quote: In the coming years, the capital expenditure investments are expected to decline.
triggers.highlight: capital expenditure investments are expected to decline

triggers.label: Wegovy pill ~50k weekly scripts
triggers.quote: as of 23 January, total weekly prescriptions amounted to around 50,000

guidance.quote: Adjusted sales growth for 2026, which excludes revenue from the reversal of 340B provisions, is expected to be -5 to -13% at CER.
Adjusted operating profit growth is expected to be -5 to -13% at CER.
Capital expenditure is expected to be around DKK 55 billion in 2026
The free cash flow is expected to be DKK 35-45 billion
The effective tax rate for 2026 is expected to be in the range of 21-23%.

red_flags.label: Q4 US sales down 15% DKK; realised prices falling
red_flags.quote: Sales in US Operations decreased by 15% measured in Danish kroner and by 7% at CER.

red_flags.label: Diabetes value share down 3.6pp
red_flags.quote: Diabetes value market share declined by 3.6 percentage points to 30.1% (MAT)
